label: Order
caption: Order of the Court
text: Supreme Court of the United States No. 20A17 (19-635) CYRUS R. VANCE, JR., IN HIS OFFICIAL CAPACITY AS DISTRICT ATTORNEY OF THE COUNTY OF NEW YORK, Applicant, v. DONALD J. TRUMP UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, and in light of the consent of President Donald J. Trump to the relief sought, IT IS ORDERED that the application for an order to issue the judgment forthwith to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is granted. /s/ John G. Roberts, Jr. Chief Justice of the United States Dated this 17th day of July, 2020.
